reviews.t: What a time and $ saver! Husband approves!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:e665708800a16847f606f1a6ca3358d4]] Purchased this for my husband who has been shaving his head since before we met! He was begging for something similar that ran about $250 😮. I couldn’t muster myself to spend $250 on a shaver when he has never actually used an electric shaver on his head before. Soooo this was my compromise! He was so excited when it arrived I don’t even think he paid attention to the fact that it wasn’t the pricey one he had been begging for! I plugged it up and we u

I bought this for my son in law for his birthday. He had just got him one. So, instead of returning it I thought I would try it for myself!!! LADIES!!! This is a shaver for us too.  The blades glided so smoothly over my knee caps and ankles! No pulling my hair! There is also a brush you can use to apply your face wash. A nose trimmer and so much more. The batter stays charged for days. It’s amazing!!

I've only used this product for 5 or 6 times and it started giving problems. I fully charged and next time I was in the shower ready to shave and battery was dead! I charged again and used it but then it started showing a lock icon. What is the heck does the lock mean? Total waste of money and a piece of junk!!!! Wish I listened to the other buyers that gave it 1 star! :(

reviews.t: Started great but went down in experience
reviews.x: If you are expecting Shave which is closer to Blade then stop. No Rotary Shaver will ever will do that. I have used Rotary Shavers for last 20 years for beard and I purchased this product with those expectations only. I bought this product for its high ratings, 5 blades vs 4 blades and digital display for battery life. I bought it for my head not face. I still use my Norelco for Beard and quite happy with it.  It started pretty good and deserved all the high ratings when I started using it new.

Got this as an alternative to wet shaving. Takes a lot longer to do my legs with this but feels nice to hold. It fits in the hand good. My bf ended up taking it over to shave his head with and he loves it. We have a different more expensive shaver for his head and he prefers this one. Came with a lot of different attachments also. For the price I would say it is worth the buy

reviews.t: Easy to use, nice and smooth
reviews.x: This head shaver was easy to use. Pulled it out of box and was already charged, started buzzing head. Head  felt nice and soft with no stubble took less than 2 minutes. Came with nose trimmer, clipper with guards and other accessories. Defiantly  well worth the price.

This shaver worked great when I first bought it.  The only real complaint that I had was that the middle piece is pretty tricky to open up and clean and get back on again.  However, after two or three months of occasional use (maybe once or twice a week) it started to die on me.  The blades got dull and it began pulling hair instead of cutting it, then the battery would not hold a charge even through a single shave.  I would not recommend purchasing this product unless you need something small a

reviews.t: Not worth it! Battery won’t take or hold a charge.
reviews.x: Not worth the purchase, it doesn’t hold a charge, it worked for about 6 weeks, being used once a week, but once the battery was depleted it was completely dead, it won’t charge.

reviews.t: Great for 30 days, then not working properly
reviews.x: On the 31st day, it started to turn on and off on it's own. I was woken up in the middle of the night by this shaver vibrating on my counter. Returned it.

reviews.t: Don't buy these Shavers!! They stop working after 1 month!!
reviews.x: Don't buy these Shavers!! They stop working after 1 month!!

That's the only "negative" thing I have to say about this shaver.  I razor my head to a smooth finish and was hoping this shaver would do the trick.  Unfortunately it doesn't get it smooth like a razor but it comes close, shorter than peach fuzz. It holds a charge for a good long time, two weeks of me using it every other day.  Keep in mind, that made using it quick, like two minutes or less to get around my head and face. The shape makes it comfortable to hold and it conforms to the head nicely

[[VIDEOID:196aee9ee5552fd2737b70d726cb32cc]] I bought this as an electric shaver for my legs. I'm black and have coarser hair and I think it worked well.  It's not as close as a razor but to the naked eye you can't tell. It kind of feels like the stubble from a day old shave. But like I said I was impressed. You do have to go over an area several times but it didn't bother me.  There was no discomfort. There were only a couple times when it seemed to catch and the pinch was very minor. I used la

I bought this as an alternative to using a razor to shave my head. Although I like the ease of use, it’s not the same as a shave with a razor and is crazy difficult to get super smooth. Understood that nothing will be close to a razor, I still expected this to be much closer.  Granted others probably won’t notice but you’ll know. I run it in the shower while my head is hot and it’s holding up well.  Also, be warned - if you do not shave your head every day or every other day at the latest, you’l

I was pleasantly surprised by the overall quality and amazed at the battery life. I haven't tried it "wet" (in the shower), but dry it gives a good although not extraordinary close shave. Overall rating isn't 5 stars only because I've had it just a few months and not sure about longevity. Opening the blade covers for cleaning is a bit fiddly so I'd suggest starting very gently the first time. Same with popping the entire head off for using accessories, the only one of which I've used is the nose

Wow!! All I can say is wow! I recently shaved my head bald and I’ve been soooo lazy when it comes to keeping up with my head having to use a disposable razor. At times I let it grow for days and then it takes about 30 minutes to actually shave. NOT WITH THIS! This product is waterproof and absolutely EFFORTLESS. I now shave my head every 2 days using this product and takes a maximum of 5 minutes while In the shower and the results are great. I would recommend this product to anyone who likes to

This shaver is saving me a lot of time and money. I use it almost every day when I wake up and it gives me a clean shave that is very very close to a razor. I get skin rash after using the razor, and this shaver is saving me from that rash. The only thing that is kind of annoying is the cleaning part. It is easy to access the trimmers, but the hair sometimes gets stuck in there and I have to spend some time cleaning in. The nose trim attachment is also useful and changing from one attachment to

Nice head shaver at a nice price. The center blade can be a pain sometimes but it dose it’s job. It makes shaving my head every other day a 5 minute job. I charge it once a week. That is when it gets down to around 30%. I would recommend this to anyone who likes to shave head. It like all electric shavers don’t get as close as a razor blade. It doesn’t pull any hair on my head but on my face is a different story. Just have to take your time.

reviews.t: It pulls hair off not shave?
reviews.x: I had to return mine. It looks like the photo but there are a few things that are off with it. The LED screen on the real one doesn’t show all the stuff like the photos or the box it came in. It’s also made of plastic so it’s very light but also not very durable. It took me a full day to charge it and when I finally used it, the battery went from 100 to 70 in just a minute. Instead of shaving it actually pulls your hair and it hurts!

This is the best thing to get hands down without any question. I am in the academy and need to have my head shaved and thIs this does the job with ease. I normally would have to trim my hair down and then use a razor and hope that I would not cut my head. I literally have used this dry on my head and it doesn’t bother me at all and won’t cut me. The shape of it makes it very easy to hold and maneuver. I would say a must buy. 100%

Great little shaver. I shave my head completely bald and also must be cleaned shave for work. This thing is great. I have not used a razor since I bought this electric shaver. Roughy 3 to 4 minutes daily for both my head and face. It even does a good job if you let it go for a couple of days. At 3 days you get some uncomfortable pulling but that's to be expected if you let it grow out to long. I highly recommend this product!

reviews.t: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR.
reviews.x: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR, and this device is no exception.  The whole thing crapped out on me maybe 1 month from pruchase.  It will not hold a charge and the motor would stick all the time and I had to hit it hard to get it going again.  Its like the connection inside the device for the battery was not very tight and would come loose.  Pay an axtra 30 or 40 bucks and get a better one.  It is an investment.

The goods arrived today with the original packaging intact. The battery is completely dead, and it shows fully charged after one hour of charging. Shaving the beard for one minute and forty-five seconds (shown) felt clean, but the sound of shaving the beard was very soft and crisp. Overall I feel good. After reading a lot of reviews, I chose to buy. Overall, I am quite satisfied

Loved it, Arrived early and fully charged. Other than that every part included was packed and sealed separately which I really liked. Tried it and it is Amazingly butter smooth.... all in one machine. A total worth spending money on. Easy to change the blades and easy to use. Perfect size and light weighted. Will order another one for my brother soon... 5 stars from my side...

It works, is the best thing i can say. It feels rough on your head like cheap blades and does NOT cut close at all. Leaves a 5 oclock shadow on your head. If you use it everyday you might be ok but dont expect a smooth clean head. I might use it for a couple months before buying a new name brand shaver. Definitely Chinese drop shipping garbage.

Nice small hand held, maybe a little small for a man's hand. Charges in less than an hour, holds charge great. I use it once a month and it stays charged in between. Face razor fills quickly and needs to be emptied often if working on a large area. Just shaved my head with it and it was wonderfully smooth, both the blade and my head lol.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a great value and time-saver, working well for head shaving and other body areas.
Several reviewers report the device stops working or fails to hold a charge after about a month to a few months of use.
Some users note the shave is not as close as a razor, though it comes reasonably close.
Reviewers describe it as easy to use, comfortable to hold, and convenient with accessories included.
A few reviewers mention difficulty opening and cleaning the device.
